title: SOTONSHIP verification proof inputs
description: Explicit input mapping and finite proof bounds accepted by the backend ProofInputsDto. Use this object directly, without a proofInputs wrapper.

cobolDialectProfile.description: The engine’s explicitly supported IBM Enterprise COBOL scalar subset; not a complete compiler profile.

cobolSourceFormat.description: Use FREE for the included example. FIXED accepts the engine’s restricted reference format.

amountField.description: Exact COBOL input amount field name.

javaAmountParameter.description: Exact Java method parameter corresponding to the COBOL input amount.

javaRateParameter.description: Exact Java method parameter corresponding to the COBOL reference rate.

amountMinCents.description: Inclusive lower input bound in integer cents; must not exceed amountMaxCents.

amountMaxCents.description: Inclusive upper input bound in integer cents.

referenceCurrencyPair.description: Exact currency pair identifying a reference-rate record in the backend.

referenceSource.description: Exact source name of the backend’s reference-rate record.
examples: Bank of England Daily Spot Rate

referenceCollectedDate.description: Exact collection date of the reference-rate record, distinct from the observation date.
